strategy.name: Aggressive Momentum (Paper)
strategy.desc: Short-to-medium-hold momentum and breakout trades in high-beta names and sector ETFs. Rides relative strength with trailing stops; cuts losers fast. Aggressive sizing inside hard guardrails — paper only.
rules: Enter on breakout above a 20-day base with above-average volume and positive relative strength.
Size by risk: shares = (7% × equity) ÷ (entry − stop), capped at 30% of equity per name.
Regime: NEUTRAL (VIX 16-24) → trim new sizes ~25%, be choosier.
Initial stop 20% trailing on every entry — never remove a stop.
Take partial profit at +6–8%; let the remainder trail.
No new entries if daily loss halt (−8%) is hit; flatten and stop for the month at −25%.
No leveraged/inverse ETFs, no crypto, no sub-$10 stocks.
